## WINDOW_FUNCTION_AND_FRAME_MISMATCH

SQLSTATE `42K0E`.

~~~text
<funcName> function can only be evaluated in an ordered row-based window frame with a single offset: <windowExpr>.
~~~

## WINDOW_FUNCTION_FRAME_NOT_ORDERED

SQLSTATE `42601`.

~~~text
Window function <wf_name> requires the window to be ordered. You need to add an ORDER BY clause. For example: SELECT <wf_expr> OVER (PARTITION BY window_partition ORDER BY window_ordering) FROM table.
~~~

## WINDOW_FUNCTION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_CLAUSE

SQLSTATE `42601`.

~~~text
It is not allowed to use window functions inside <clauseName> clause.
~~~

## WINDOW_FUNCTION_PARTITION_SIZE_EXCEEDS_LIMIT

SQLSTATE `54000`.

~~~text
Cannot evaluate the window function because the window partition has <numRows> rows, which exceeds the maximum of 2,147,483,647 (2^31 - 1) rows supported per window partition. Reduce the partition size, for example by adding more expressions to the PARTITION BY clause.
~~~

## WINDOW_FUNCTION_WITHOUT_OVER_CLAUSE

SQLSTATE `42601`.

~~~text
Window function <funcName> requires an OVER clause.
~~~
